name: Spaghetti Squash Carbonara
notes: Keto, and declared a “hit” by Levi, Summer 2020.

steps.title: Bake the squash
steps.body: Cut **1 large spaghetti squash** in half and bake in a 375°F oven until tender, cut side down, about 45 minutes.

steps.title: Heat the bacon and garlic
steps.body: In a large frying pan, heat together **1 Tbsp olive oil**, **¾ cup bacon bits** (cooked) and **4 cloves garlic** (minced).

steps.title: Add the peas
steps.body: Add **½ cup green peas** and sauté until warm.

steps.title: Whisk the egg mixture
steps.body: In a bowl, whisk together **1 large egg**, **6 Tbsp heavy cream** and **½ cup grated Parmesan cheese**.

steps.title: Pull the noodles
steps.body: When squash is baked, use a fork to pull out the “noodles.”

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: While still very hot, add the egg/cream/cheese mixture, then the **½ cup green peas** and **¾ cup bacon bits**.

steps.title: Season
steps.body: Toss together and season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve, garnished with fresh parsley and additional Parmesan.

yields: Serves 2 as a main, 4 as a side (estimated)
